title: Semitoric systems with $2n$ Focus-Focus singularities
summary: In this paper, we provide new explicit examples of semitoric systems. More precisely, for any natural number $n$, we give a semtioric moment map $F_n$ with $2n$ focus-focus singularities defined on a symplectic manifold $(M_n,ω_n)$ of diffeomorphism type $\mathbb{CP}^2\sharp(2n+1)\overline{\mathbb{CP}}{}^2$.
